verdict.rationale: Cake's capital-raise feature mentions communicating with investors during a raise (docs-7), and the help-centre probe references a 'My Cap' vs 'Company View' distinction implying some investor-facing view exists, but there is no explicit documentation of an ongoing investor portal for holdings or structured update broadcasts outside of the raise workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated investor portal documentation, structured update/reporting feature description, evidence of investors viewing holdings without founder intervention.
